verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe an MCP connector that lets the Messages API connect to remote MCP servers directly, with no separate MCP client. It supports allowlisting or denylisting specific tools. MCP tunnels extend this to servers inside a private network. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the connector working in practice, and evidence of support for local (stdio) MCP servers beyond the remote and tunneled options.
